Title: Tak and the Power of Juju
FullTitle: Tak and the Power of Juju
SortTitle: Tak and the Power of Juju
Plot: Tak is a preteen shaman tasked with protecting the Pupununu tribe from certain destruction with his newfound gift: the power of juju. With it, he can cast spells, explore new worlds, and summon powerful creatures at the wave of his magic staff. Unfortunately, however, Tak's magic has a habit of causing more trouble than it fixes.
